messages.content: Hey Jane, why did you block my other account? We really need to talk. Unblock me now.
Stop ignoring me! I made this new account just to reach you. You can't just pretend I don't exist.
I saw you at your gym today wearing that blue jacket. Who was that guy you were laughing with outside?
I see your apartment bedroom light is still on. You can't hide from me. Why won't you answer my calls?
PICK UP THE PHONE RIGHT NOW OR YOU WILL REGRET THIS!
You think moving helped? I know where you live: 742 Evergreen Terrace, Apt 4B. I am parked outside your house right now watching your window.
I have your phone number +1-555-019-2834 and your work email jane.doe@techcorp.io. Tomorrow morning I will email your manager and post on twitter to ruin your career.
I will destroy you and leak your private photos unless you reply in 10 minutes. This is your last chance. Watch your back.
